I was recently with a tour group staying overnight on way to another destination. Several of my friends and I wanted to see the temple and we were told that we were only about 5 blocks. It was about 6 pm and it was dark. We encountered those scooters laying EVERYWHERE on the side walks. 😖😖. We tried to be very careful however on way back one of my friends tripped over them😖😖. She and her friend had to cut their time short and go back home as her arm was injured as well as her ankle!! I'm just telling you this because I believe it's a very dangerous situation and I expected better from your city!! And perhaps you can devise a better way to deal with them😖😖😖😖 Sent from my iPhone
